title: Add local TUI replay script
purpose: Create a deterministic local replay that proves the TUI-oriented operator workflows end to end.
scope: Run scripted TUI flows for dashboard, submit, plan, advance, approve, deny, recover, audit, support and aom projection.
Record command evidence, output hashes and final status JSON.
Fail closed when any required TUI flow is missing.
Keep replay local-only with no external LLM, network, Firecracker or host package manager requirement.
acceptance_criteria: TUI replay exercises the same parser and controller as interactive mode.
Replay evidence includes command list, expected rejections and output hashes.
Replay fails if approval, recovery, support or ecosystem views are absent.
Replay has deterministic output across repeated runs.
failure_modes: Replay bypasses TUI parser or controller.
Replay depends on host network or external services.
